question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** "peaks".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Peaks - **The point at which something is the highest.
 
• The given statement in the questions means that winter sowing begins in October and sowing is highest in November. 
 
• **Example -** *Electronics sale peak around the Diwali season.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Leaks -** A small crack or space from where a gas or liquid gets out.

 
 
• **​Example - ***The water supply pipe is leaking.*
 
 
 
• **Creaks -** It is a noise of something which is not moving smoothly.
 
 
• **​Example -*** The chair creaks.*​
 
 
 
• **Falls -** To drop down suddenly.
 
 
• **Example - ***He fell off the stairs.*
